title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 13: Abijah's speech on Mount Zemaraim and Judah's victory over Jeroboam.

questions.text: In which year of King Jeroboam did Abijah begin to reign over Judah?
questions.explanation: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.

questions.text: What was the name of Abijah's mother in this chapter?
questions.explanation: His mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah.

answers.text: Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah
Jezebel the daughter of the king of Sidon

questions.text: How many chosen men did Jeroboam set in battle array against Abijah?
questions.explanation: Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men.

questions.text: On which mountain did Abijah stand up to speak to Jeroboam and all Israel?
questions.explanation: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim.

questions.text: By what kind of covenant did Abijah say Yahweh gave the kingdom to David and his sons?
questions.explanation: Abijah said Yahweh gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, to him and his sons, by a covenant of salt.

questions.text: According to Abijah, what could anyone bring to consecrate himself as a priest in Israel?
questions.explanation: He said whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.

answers.text: A young bull and seven rams

questions.text: What did Jeroboam cause to come about behind the army of Judah?
questions.explanation: Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them, so the battle was before and behind Judah.

questions.text: What did the men of Judah do just before God struck Jeroboam and all Israel?
questions.explanation: The men of Judah gave a shout, and as they shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel.

answers.text: They sang a song of David

questions.text: Which city with its villages did Abijah take from Jeroboam?
questions.explanation: Abijah took Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages and Ephron with its villages.

questions.text: How many wives did Abijah take for himself?
questions.explanation: Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives.
